mission.goal: Build an evidence-gated, continuously refreshable benchmark and mission-control knowledge plane for JARVIS.
mission.workflow: source registry -> freshness gate -> proof-weighted benchmark -> opportunity fan-in -> authorized append-only learning transaction
mission.data: official source metadata, JARVIS truth-state evidence, benchmark dimensions, observations and hash-chained cycle commits
mission.interface: dependency-free CLI and JSON HTTP API
mission.stack: Node.js 24 standard library and JSON/JSONL storage
mission.environment: local candidate; container-ready; no production host authorized
mission.governance: Formation single-use permits, documentation-first preflight, 50-horizon digital twin, zero authority expansion
mission.failure: fail closed on stale critical evidence, identity mismatch, invalid input, ledger corruption, idempotency conflict and missing write authorization
mission.testing: node:test unit, integration, HTTP, CLI, failure-first and tamper tests
mission.deployment: container candidate only; deployment not executed
mission.continuity: append-only ledger restore, idempotency, stop switch and handoff files

assumptions.runtime: single writer per ledger guarded by an exclusive lock; multiple read-only clients supported
assumptions.storage: bounded local JSONL ledger is the source of truth; durable production storage remains a deployment decision
assumptions.authentication: writes disabled by default; bearer token required for API commits
assumptions.deployment: private managed container runtime with TLS, secret manager, identity and scheduler after authorization

components.frontend: JSON CLI output and HTTP JSON responses; no browser UI in lane one
components.backend: Node.js benchmark, freshness, opportunity, collection and commit engine
components.database: append-only JSONL knowledge ledger with materialized registry restored on startup
components.queue: bounded refresh plan ordered by staleness, criticality and next due date
components.worker: HTTPS source collector with timeout, response-size and identity boundaries
components.scheduler: optional daemon interval; implemented but not installed or deployed
components.cache: in-memory current registry/evaluation snapshot; recoverable from ledger
components.storage: base JSON registries plus hash-chained JSONL transactions
components.authentication: loopback default plus constant-time bearer-token check for the sole write route

observability.correlation_ids: Every HTTP response carries x-correlation-id; safe supplied IDs are preserved.
observability.health_checks: GET /health reports runtime, write state and ledger verification.
observability.structured_logs: Server and daemon emit bounded JSON events without request bodies or secrets.
observability.audit_logs: Every committed cycle is idempotent, hash-chained and fully verified before and after append.
observability.metrics_alerts: Freshness counts, critical source issues, score deltas and collection failures are machine-readable; external alert routing is pending deployment.

testing.unit: freshness, scoring, truth-state weighting, observation validation and Mission Utility formula
testing.integration: cycle engine, collector contracts, ledger restore and authenticated commit path
testing.e2e_or_smoke: real local HTTP server plus CLI subprocess validation
testing.fixtures_mocks: fixed-date source registry, JARVIS state, mocked HTTPS responses and isolated temporary ledgers
testing.failure_first: stale evidence, URL substitution, duplicate observations, redirect, oversized source, bad token, idempotency conflict and tamper detection

delivery.file_tree: README, security/governance/continuity documents, src modules, data registries, examples, tests, Dockerfile, proofs and BUILD_CONTRACT.json
deploy_commands: Deploy only after a fresh Formation A2 permit and managed-secret/runtime configuration.
rollback_commands: Stop the candidate, restore the prior verified image and ledger checkpoint, then run ledger-verify before resuming.
delivery.debugging: Use correlation ID, structured log event, /health, /v1/ledger/verify, refresh-plan and the first failing deterministic test.

formation.effectful_permit: Sanitized single-use local build receipts in governance/permit_receipts.json

watchman.freshness: critical-source SLA gate and bounded due-source queue
watchman.security: identity-pinned collection, disabled-by-default writes and full ledger verification
watchman.deployment: pending managed monitoring and alert routing

continuity.idempotency: 8-160 character idempotency key bound to an exact payload hash; conflicting reuse is rejected
continuity.checkpoints: every valid ledger head is a checkpoint; the latest cycle carries the full registry snapshot
continuity.resume_conditions: valid hash chain, inactive STOP switch, current mission and authorized runtime configuration
continuity.stop_switch: A STOP file prevents daemon refresh cycles; process signals stop the HTTP server gracefully.

proof.test_results: 24/24 tests passed; 87.50% line, 65.98% branch and 89.53% function coverage; proofs/VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json
proof.semantic_verification: CLI validation, ledger verification, fail-closed stale evidence, source identity, authenticated idempotent commit, tamper detection and daemon no-op smoke checks passed.
